name: NATS
summary: TCP 4222 with the check aimed at the monitoring port.
notes: Clients use 4222 while the check asks /healthz on the monitoring port, 8222, which is off until http_port is set or the server is started with -m 8222. A NATS server tells its clients the addresses of the rest of the cluster and they connect to those directly from then on; set no_advertise, or client_advertise to the address published here, to keep them coming through this service.
